topic: Plan a migration from session cookies to short-lived JWTs with refresh rotation in the fixture repo.

agents.reply: Propose a token service issuing 10 minute access tokens, rotating refresh tokens stored server-side, and a dual-read period for existing cookies.
Refresh rotation without reuse detection is a theft vector, and the dual-read period has no exit criteria or rollback.
Ship behind a flag per tenant, measure login error rate, and cut scope: no SSO changes in this milestone.
